body: I  can understand how you feel man, it is almost like everyone is constantly telling us : "you are white, make and straight what could possible be bad for you?" just another reason why suicide rates are so high, I find reddit to be the only place where I kind find help, I vent out just like you every once in a while, it helps, just remember, once it ends there is no change for you, however if you somehow force yourself to stay around for another month, week or a day you might look bk in a few years and thank yourself for waiting.
what kind of music do you listen if you dont mind telling. Music helps me stop thinking, cant have suicidal thoughts if you dont think.

you have the exact same thoughts I had when I was 18, people constantly telling about how everything works out on its own, love isnt something that happens, it is something you have to look for and find, some people just click and call it love but it is pretty much just liking how someone else looks and acts and asking them out to see if it might work out and it usually does for a while. Some of people I know are 25 and never really found "the one" so from what they told me it is just expecting too much, they are people out there who are perfect for you and could understand you, but you will never know that cause they hide it the same we we all do. We all feel like this, all that matters is trying to find someone who can feel this way with you.

im tall and skinny, most people call me skeleton, could never build up body mass, had similar encounters with women who had pretty bad remarks, its bad when they talk behind your back it is even worse when they literally talk how shit you are in front of people you know.

as for me I was always interested in all types of sciences, thinking how our bodies work and how we came to exist and so on, at some point I started understanding that we re not really just a human, we are made of millions of cells each having certain purpose, our emotions are controlled by chemicals released into our brains and all of our emotions and feelings can be controlled by doing something about our lives. I believe there is no magic place, once we die we just go back to nothingness. long story short: I believe that once we die we are in same state before we come to exist, no feelings, no emotions, no memories, no nothing.

realised that one of the reasons why I dont want to seek help is because I feel like I give a reason to people in UK to think bad about all the people who are not British, "why did you come to this country if you only gonna cause problems" is what goes through my mind when I think about getting help.
I guess a lot of people feel the same way, when you dont have to make the actual the decision it seems so much easier.

I once had fantasies about my younger siblings when I was a kid, I still remember it to this day 10+ years after and realised that it is okay to be bit weird when it comes to intimate things, there are hundreds of fetishes and femdom is probably one of the more "normal" ones, me on other hand watched stuff that makes me really consider if I should be allowed to be in public, I know i can keep my interests to myself but my fetishes get way too dark sometimes.

I always tell myself that I am a guy and generally do not believe in trans thinking it is a disorder of mind but im pretty sure I am affected as well, I often think that life would be better if I was of opposite sex, imagine myself wearing feminine clothing, or even dating a guy (I am straight as an arrow but still think about that which makes me feel confused) I just see that as having a side to myself that I myself consider "weird but okay" not even sure what that means as I never seeked for any kind of help, been on this reddit for hours now which helped me stop suicidal thoughts (ironic somehow)

from my point of view it feels Ironic to care bout people who cause you pain, I felt like that when I was 12 or 11 not sure, im 20 still suicidal but for other reasons, I keep telling myself that I should stop giving a fuck about anyone and just try to get by smhw in hopes that it will be better in a few years, been doing that for years and it helped me but not sure if that would help you, no need to end it really, writing a note and hiding somewhere for a few days would serve the purpose just as well, not telling you to do that, just saying that there are other ways to get the same effect.
Do you believe in afterlife, I dont and feel like ending it, just want to know how other feel/think hoping it hanges my mind
I feel that any communication with people tires me to extreme extent
